_help: The order the game is played in. Each stage has a name (shown in the banner), a kind (level or boss: how it is described
when cleared) and what to build:
level:<file>   a normal level from levels/<file>.txt, cleared by reaching its exit door
boss:pell      the Pell arena (levels/pell.txt)       boss:dova   the Dova arena (levels/dova.txt)
keep           the Tithe Keep hub and its four rooms (levels/keep_*.txt)
